question: Should iMessage adopt the same assistant-visible outbound filtering policy already used by sibling channels, accepting removal of text classified as internal scaffolding?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and follows established sibling patterns, but the remaining decision is whether the channel should intentionally suppress this broader class of user-visible text.

options.title: Accept sibling-channel parity
options.body: Approve the iMessage-local canonical sanitizer after refreshing the merge result, so iMessage recipients no longer receive internal tool-call scaffolding.

options.title: Hold for shared policy design
options.body: Defer this channel slice until maintainers choose a universal outbound-sanitization policy for the remaining channels.
